scope: Authenticated owner-test browser acceptance for frontend.8 service-worker reload protection
execution_gate: Require a fresh owner-test auth file and explicit root GO. Supply a unique attempt label; the runner refuses to overwrite existing private or public receipts.
scenario: Launch an owned headless Chromium profile at 1280x800 with ordinary service-worker behavior.
Install passive document, controllerchange, dirty-state, request, and websocket telemetry before navigation.
Authenticate, visit /owner-test then /home/overview, and verify admin, canonical session, idle chat, and dirty-provider API.
Require the actual hashed chat entry, strings.js, voice.js, and rendered chat textarea to be ready before proceeding.
Proceed only if the fresh profile has a real installing service worker with no active controller or prior controllerchange.
Enter a non-sent draft through trusted keyboard input; require the chat provider to publish global dirty.
Wait up to 150 seconds for a native trusted controllerchange; require same document, chat instance, owner/session, retained draft, and no document navigation while dirty.
Confirm textarea focus, clear via trusted keyboard events using explicit modifier down/up, and capture text length/hash, focus, selection, chat flags, aggregate dirty, and other dirty providers.
After the normal global-clean event, wait up to 75 seconds for the deferred reload; verify same owner/session and an empty draft.
pass_criteria: The first real service-worker controllerchange occurs after the unsent draft is dirty.
No top-level document navigation occurs between draft input and global clean.
The same chat component retains the draft across controllerchange.
A document reload occurs only after the draft clears and the frontend reports clean.
The post-reload page retains the authenticated owner and canonical chat session with an empty draft.
No assistant run, config mutation, or Home Assistant service call is observed.
stop_conditions: Runtime image/source/hotfix hashes do not match the expected build.
Auth file is older than 20 minutes or has an invalid shape.
The worker is already active or controlling before draft input; stop without resetting or unregistering it.
Admin/session/runtime is not idle, provider API is unavailable, or any unexpected asset/page error occurs.
Any model run, config mutation, or HA service call is observed.

keyboard_regression.purpose: Use the installed Puppeteer CdpKeyboard implementation to reject invalid chord strings and verify modifier cleanup.

limits: Browser scenario covers the chat provider only; native editor coexistence remains source-test evidence.
No chat message, model prompt, device command, config write, or helper action is sent.
evidence_index: See frontend8-reload-guard-manifest.json for attempts 1-6 and source-archive SHA links.
